title: Concept: Lockfile resolves packages from a third-party registry host
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry served by a host other than the configured public registry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every package in the tree is fetched from a host the review process never covered, so its publication controls and provenance are unknown.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Every package in the tree is fetched from a host the review process never covered, so its publication controls and provenance are unknown.
